title: On the distribution of rational points on ramified covers of abelian varieties
authors: Pietro Corvaja, Julian Lawrence Demeio, Ariyan Javanpeykar, Davide Lombardo, Umberto Zannier

used_locators.scope: Definition of the division and torsion fields and the Kummer kernel N_m.
Uniform bound on [A[m]:N_m] for an arbitrary nondegenerate point on an abelian variety over a number field; no indivisibility assumption is required.

role: External theorem interface; not claimed to be reproved by finite checks.
